dictionaryDefinitions.name: luajit-moonscript
dictionaryDefinitions.description: The LuaJIT + MoonScript + Lua 5.1 delta that @cspell/dict-lua omits: bit ops, removed 5.1 builtins, MoonScript, and Lua concept/prose terms. Reusable across LuaJIT/MoonScript projects.

dictionaryDefinitions.name: ffi
dictionaryDefinitions.description: C API symbols bound via LuaJIT FFI: POSIX, Windows, and libcurl. Reusable across FFI-using projects.

dictionaryDefinitions.name: fonts
dictionaryDefinitions.description: Typography and font-format vocabulary: OpenType/TrueType table tags, font-file jargon, and typographic concepts, whichever library exposes them. Reusable across font-handling projects.

dictionaryDefinitions.name: ass
dictionaryDefinitions.description: Advanced SubStation Alpha format vocabulary: override tag names, section and field names, and the jargon of the format itself. Terms come from a specification and from renderers, so they are spelled as those spell them and cannot be renamed. Font and typography words go in `fonts` even when a tag mentions them; this repository's own identifiers go in `project`.

dictionaryDefinitions.name: project
dictionaryDefinitions.description: Everything specific to this repo and the DepCtrl ecosystem: own identifiers, rock/tool proper nouns, and prose jargon. Quick-added words land here.
